Strategy: For items of size forty or more reward residuals between forty-five and sixty, keeping the mid penalty always on. Large items need roomier leftovers, but the thresholds are guesses and the band may rarely engage.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if item >= 40 and r - item >= 45 and r - item <= 60 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
